newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Canberra jobs claim baseless-Australian opp'n.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Canberra jobs claim baseless-Australian opp'n.

text.p: The Australian opposition said that Reserve Bank of Australia governor Ian Macfarlane had failed to support the government's claim that jobs would flow from passage of its industrial relations bill.

"The story that the government has been peddling, the only story that they've had about jobs, is now non-existent, blown completely out of the water," opposition treasury spokesman Gareth Evans told reporters on Wednesday.
Earlier on Wednesday, Macfarlane told an economists conference he was "agnostic" about whether passage of the bill would lead to increased jobs.
"Can I say that I'm agnostic on that," Macfarlane said.
"It is quite possible that it will have very little effect on employment and most of the effect will be on productivity and long run growth."
The government has said on numerous occasions that an improvement in Australia's unemployment situation depended on passage of the bill through the Senate, where it does not have a clear majority.
The opposition Labor Party has said it will oppose the legislation, which reduces the influence of the union movement.
